gen-dafont-dogica-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads like a classic serif with some backbone, its heavy downstrokes meeting slender turns on a generous x-height. Dogica sits above it, wide-spaced and chunky, giving the page a loud top note.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps its curves open and lightly modulated, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals. And Dogica, wide and heavy above it, shouts where the body only murmurs.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-ovo: Authoritative is the mood Ovo carries, its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks and its middle band tall and spacious. Dogica, blocky and wide, takes the loud role.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-domine: Dignified and a little formal, Domine tucks short ascenders above tall lowercase, with room inside every curve. Early GameBoy is the playful shouter, while Domine does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-esteban: Esteban reads open and friendly, its lowercase almost oversized beside the capitals. Early GameBoy earns its keep when it runs big and brief, spaced wide and playful, leaving Esteban to carry the rest.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-faustina: Faustina brings a classic serif voice with authority. Its bowls thin gently, its c gapes like pliers, and its capitals barely top the lowercase, so a long passage moves along smoothly beneath Early GameBoy's playful, stretched-out headline.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-halant: Halant reads sturdy and traditional, its tall x-height crowding the line. Over a longer stretch its outward-pointing terminals keep the text feeling firm, a steady counterweight to Early GameBoy's wide-spaced, playful swagger up top.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-headland-one: Headland One reads spaced out and dignified, each letter clear of its neighbor. Early GameBoy brings the playful bravado up top, and the two feel like a jester standing beside a courtly host.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-hedvig-lette: Wide-set, skyward letters mark Early GameBoy at once. It does its best work as a loud, playful opener, while Hedvig Letters Serif does its best as the sturdy, open-curved text beneath.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa reads sturdy and editorial, its counters spilling into the space around tall lowercase. Lisu Bosa gives Early GameBoy's wide, playful capitals a grounded partner, tempering all that bravado with a lightly sprung contrast.
